units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:12">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:12">Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. (diff. fr. <cite ref="K01175"><he>כריעה</he></cite>). Ib. 3ᵈ top <he>לך ב׳</he> unto thee bending is due; a. e.

senses.gloss: (denomin. of בֶּרֶךְ) knee, young shoot. Orlah I, 5 if a tree has been dying ובו ב׳ וכ׳ but there is a shoot on it …: the old stem is again like a young shoot (with ref. to the fruits of the first years, v. עָרְלָה).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 15b:5">R. Hash. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:20">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 20</cite> ed. Zuck. <he>אילן העושה ב׳ אחת</he> (ed. <he>ברך</he>) a tree which shoots only once a year (its fruits growing all at once), opp. <he>שתי בריכות</he> (expl. R. Hash. l. c. <he>כעין שתי ב׳</he>) two crops, i.e. early and late fruits.

senses.gloss: (from the position of the hatching bird) brood, esp. of doves.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:3">B. Bath. V, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 10a:11">Bets. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ ראשונה</he> the first brood of the year.—Pl. <he>בְּרִיכוֹת</he>. R. Hash. l. c.; Tosef. Shebi. l. c.
